posts.title: The Pit of Success, and What a Data Science Language Would Need to Make It
posts.description: Rico Mariani, a long-time performance engineer at Microsoft, coined the idea of the pit of success . A system has a pit of success when the natural, lazy way of using it leads to good outcomes. You don’t need heroics or perfect memory.
